brainstorming.instruction: Generate several distinct hypotheses, expose drawbacks, and rank the next checks.

research.instruction: Synthesize only the supplied repository evidence or cited sources. Mark every unsupported or time-sensitive claim as unknown.

batch_test.instruction: Propose or classify bounded tests. Never claim that a command ran; return exact test intent and expected evidence.

implementation.instruction: Draft the smallest coherent implementation or patch, including failure modes and tests. Do not edit files or run commands.

code_review.instruction: Review supplied code for concrete correctness, safety, provenance, leakage, and test gaps. Cite file and line evidence when available.

deep_review.instruction: Act as a rare second-opinion reviewer. Re-evaluate assumptions, identify hidden coupling, and distinguish blocking findings from uncertainty.

result_interpretation.instruction: Interpret supplied results without changing the protocol after seeing metrics. Separate observations, causal limits, regressions, and next hypotheses.

orchestration.instruction: Produce a bounded dependency-aware plan. Keep destructive actions, Git publication, locked-test access, and final authority with Codex and the user.

performance_judge.instruction: Judge anonymized model outputs against a fixed rubric. Never replace objective throughput, memory, test, or correctness measurements.
